verdicts.reason: A moves the headline and copy into a cramped block at the top, demotes the iconic shape row (the original's hero) to a small strip mid-canvas with dead space above and below, and strands the 3-day-event body text at the bottom, below the URL it points to ('follow the link:' ends with nothing after it). B keeps the original order (shapes at top, then headline, then pink subhead) and stays faithful. Its flaws: the blocks are spread out with large, roughly equal gaps, so they read as loose fragments; the URL still comes before 'follow the link:'; the body text is tiny with tight spacing ('IN NY' reads as 'INNY').
